verdict.rationale: Docs show each transaction is recorded and retrievable (CreateTransaction, GetTransactions, transaction detail lookup) and that AvaTax can explain jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing decisions, exemption status, and compliance rules (avalara-docs-28, -18, -8, -4/15/22), plus address validation (avalara-docs-2) and tax-code/category suggestions (avalara-docs-7). However, no explicit documentation of a dedicated audit-export feature, retention/immutability guarantees, or a bundled report that ties rate+rules+address+category together in one exportable audit record. Missing for 10: explicit audit-export or compliance-report API, documented retention policy, independent/hands-on confirmation of audit usability.
